otWelcomeDesc: STAGE is a competitive football management platform where you play, manage, and grow. Here's a quick overview of how everything works.
otClubDesc: Your club starts with 50,000 STC (Stage Currency). Use it to sign players, pay salaries, and build your squad. Manage your transfer budget and wage budget wisely.
otCurrencyDesc: STAGE has two separate currencies. Credits are used for platform features like tournaments and subscriptions. STC (Stage Currency) is the in-game economy — used for salaries, transfers, and lifestyle.
otContractsDesc: Offer contracts to players with weekly salaries, signing bonuses, and performance targets. Players can accept, reject, or counter-offer. Transfers execute when the transfer window opens.
otContractsHighlight: Salaries paid monthly in real time
otMarketDesc: Every player has a market value based on their overall rating, goals, assists, and match performance. Higher value means better contract negotiations and more leverage in the transfer market.
otLifestyleSubtitle: Spend your STC. Build your empire.
otLifestyleDesc: Earn STC through salaries and performance. Spend it on real estate, vehicles, clothing, and events. Some assets generate passive STC income over time.
